ectopic expression of Cva (Vasa homologue) in chicken embryonic stem (ESC) cells can reprogram them into a germ cell fate, both in vitro (in the presence of BMP4) and in vivo (in host embryos).
the expression of Cvh induces chicken embryonic stem cell differentiation towards the germline.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms underlying germline programming, and the role of the Vasa gene in germ cell development and differentiation in birds.
the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms underlying the germline competence of chicken embryonic cells.
understanding the genetic determinism of germline reprogramming.

Vasa expression in combination with specific culture conditions induces cESC re-programming to a germ cell-like fate, which may be useful for the production of transgenic chickens.
